post.description: Username + password (argon2id). Success sets the signed session cookie (HttpOnly, SameSite=Strict, Path=/admin, 12 hours). Five failures in a row lock every login for 15 minutes (423 ADMIN_LOGIN_LOCKED, `detailsSafe.retryAfterSeconds`, `Retry-After`). Only one login is verified at a time; a concurrent one is 429 ADMIN_LOGIN_BUSY (not counted, `Retry-After: 1`). The lock lives in process memory and a restart clears it (Decision 0105).

post.summary: Verify or reject a community application
post.description: Runs the existing review path (Decision 0073: status, community audit row, owner notification and push) and records a review note plus console audit rows: `community.review.requested` before the review runs (when it cannot be written: 503 ADMIN_AUDIT_UNAVAILABLE, nothing changes), then `community.review.decided` (with the note) or `community.review.failed` (Decision 0105). `reject` needs `reasonText` (the applicant reads it). Rejecting a verified community is 409 ADMIN_CONFLICT (ADMIN_COMMUNITY_ALREADY_VERIFIED). Repeating the current decision is 200 with `changed: false`.

reasonText.description: Required for `reject` (stored on the community; the applicant reads it in the App). Optional for `verify`.

post.description: Signs `pause(token)` on the curve with the operator key (MEME_OPERATOR_PRIVATE_KEY, testnet only; Decision 0105) after a dry run, and answers 202 once broadcast. Audit rows: `meme.pause.requested` before anything is signed (when it cannot be written: 503 ADMIN_AUDIT_UNAVAILABLE, nothing signed), then `meme.pause.submitted` or `meme.pause.failed`. The token status follows when the meme_event lane indexes the Paused log. A pause/unpause of the same token still in flight or not yet mined → 409 MEME_PAUSE_PENDING. Key missing or contract unconfigured → 503 with reasonCode (MEME_OPERATOR_KEY_MISSING, MEME_CONTRACT_NOT_CONFIGURED, MEME_MAINNET_SIGNING_CLOSED, MEME_CHAIN_RPC_NOT_CONFIGURED). Wrong state or a reverting dry run → 409.

reasonText.description: Trimmed, 1-280 code points, no control characters.
